command:
set -eu
printf 'node=%s\n' "$NODE_NAME"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running 2>&1 || true
printf 'passwd_entry=[REDACTED]group_entry='; getent group inventorysvc
uid=$(id -u inventorysvc)
sys_min=$(awk '$1=="SYS_UID_MIN"{print $2}' /etc/login.defs)
sys_max=$(awk '$1=="SYS_UID_MAX"{print $2}' /etc/login.defs)
printf 'system_uid_check=uid:%s configured_range:%s-%s result:' "$uid" "$sys_min" "$sys_max"
if [ "$uid" -ge "$sys_min" ] && [ "$uid" -le "$sys_max" ]; then printf 'PASS\n'; else printf 'FAIL\n'; exit 1; fi
stat -c 'home_check=type:%F owner:%U group:%G mode:%a path:%n' /var/lib/inventory
printf 'password_status=[REDACTED]id' 2>&1)
login_rc=$?
set -e
printf 'interactive_login_attempt=rc:%s output:%s\n' "$login_rc" "$login_output"
if [ "$login_rc" -eq 0 ]; then printf 'nologin_check=FAIL\n'; exit 1; else printf 'nologin_check=PASS\n'; fi
